'''Pokémon Short Comics''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンショートコント''' ''Pokémon Short Stories'') is the second special chapter of the [[Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire]] manga.

==Plot==
In the first story, {{TP|Red|Clefairy}} shouts at the clock to hurry up. Then, a {{p|Hoothoot}} appears and yells at Clefairy for disturbing its sleep. 

In the second story, Clefairy looks up at the night sky and talks about the stars.
